Dear Enterprise Client 5,

Thank you for bringing the delay of your replacement parts order #ORD-8819 to our attention. We understand how critical timely delivery is for your operations, and we sincerely apologize for the inconvenience this has caused.

- Checking the carrier’s tracking portal for the latest status and any exception codes.
- Initiating a carrier investigation if the shipment has not been delivered or if an exception is identified.
- Escalating the case to our Logistics Management team should the carrier be unable to locate the shipment or if the investigation exceeds the standard 2‑business‑day response window.

We expect to receive an initial response from the carrier within 1‑2 business days. Once we have an update, we will promptly inform you of the next steps, which may include arranging a replacement shipment at no cost or issuing a full refund, based on inventory availability and your preference.

We will follow up with you within the next 24 hours to confirm that the escalation has been made and to provide a timeline for resolution.

Thank you for your patience and understanding. Please let us know if there are any changes to your shipping address or if you have any additional questions.

Sincerely,
Customer Support Team
